detail.title: Journal: Synthesis of Historical Expert Disagreement and Research Reorientation for Music Cognition
detail.summary: We have synthesized the available historical evidence regarding the British Association for the Advancement of Science to produce a provisional notebook for project proj-disagreement-001, focusing on how institutional structures shaped expert consensus and disagreement. Project proj-music-002 remains stalled due to an evidence mismatch; the previously mapped historical sources were irrelevant to the predictive processing of musical tension, necessitating new domain-specific research. The overdue commitment regarding error detection remains open as we prioritize the synthesis of active, evidence-supported projects.

children.title: The Institutional Geography of Expert Disagreement

detail.title: The Institutional Geography of Expert Disagreement
detail.summary: This provisional synthesis examines how scientific societies in the 19th and 20th centuries structured expert consensus and dissent, using the British Association for the Advancement of Science as a model case.
detail.reason: The evidence provides a concrete historical basis for how experts in the same discipline reached different conclusions based on institutional framing.
